---
# agd-v2/edge-ai-inference-lab/prod.yaml
__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: "Edge AI Inference Lab"
  deployer:
    type: agnosticd
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main
    controller: west
    # GPU-capable execution nodes; image pulls are large, so this item is pinned
    instance_group: exec-pool-b

cloud_provider: aws
aws_region: us-west-2
bastion_instance_type: m6i.xlarge
bastion_root_volume_size: 200
ocp4_installer_version: "4.18"
ocp4_workload_nvidia_gpu_operator_enable: true
